info.name: Declut API
info.description:
Declut — escrow marketplace API for pre-owned household items. NestJS + MongoDB.

Run Auth → Register or Login first (auto-saves accessToken/refreshToken). Admin routes need a separate token from Admin Auth → Admin login. baseUrl defaults to http://localhost:3000/api.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Google sign-in or email/phone + password, converging on JWT access/refresh tokens.

request.description: Sends a 6-digit email verification OTP. Response includes emailVerified and kycStatus.

item.name: Users
item.description: Profile, KYC status, trust score, rating stats. One user type — anyone can buy or sell.

item.name: Admin Auth
item.description: Admin is a separate collection with its own JWT secrets — a regular user token never works here.
